verses.original: Τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ Χριστὸς ἠλευθέρωσεν ἡμᾶς στήκετε οὖν καὶ μὴ ἐνέχεσθε πάλιν ζυγῷ δουλείας
verses.transliteration: Tē eleutheria Christos ēleutherōsen hēmas stēkete oun kai mē enechesthe palin zygō douleias
verses.literal: [It is] for freedom [that] Christ has set us free . . . Stand firm then and {do} not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery

verses.original: Ἴδε ἐγὼ Παῦλος λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν περιτέμνησθε Χριστὸς ὠφελήσει οὐδὲν ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ide egō Paulos legō hymin hoti ean peritemnēsthe Christos ōphelēsei ouden hymas
verses.literal: Take notice I Paul tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised Christ will be of no value . . . to you {at all}

verses.original: δὲ πάλιν μαρτύρομαι παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ περιτεμνομένῳ ὅτι ἐστὶν ὀφειλέτης ποιῆσαι τὸν ὅλον νόμον
verses.transliteration: de palin martyromai panti anthrōpō peritemnomenō hoti estin opheiletēs poiēsai ton holon nomon
verses.literal: vvv Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law

verses.original: οἵτινες δικαιοῦσθε ἐν νόμῳ κατηργήθητε ἀπὸ Χριστοῦ ἐξεπέσατε τῆς χάριτος
verses.transliteration: hoitines dikaiousthe en nomō katērgēthēte apo Christou exepesate tēs charitos
verses.literal: {You} who are [trying] to be justified by [the] law have been severed from Christ you have fallen away from grace

verses.original: γὰρ ἐκ πίστεως Ἡμεῖς ἀπεκδεχόμεθα Πνεύματι ἐλπίδα δικαιοσύνης
verses.transliteration: gar ek pisteōs Hēmeis apekdechometha Pneumati elpida dikaiosynēs
verses.literal: [But] by faith we eagerly await through [the] Spirit [the] hope of righteousness

verses.original: γὰρ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ οὔτε περιτομή οὔτε ἀκροβυστία ἰσχύει τι ἀλλὰ πίστις ἐνεργουμένη δι’ ἀγάπης
verses.transliteration: gar en Christō Iēsou oute peritomē oute akrobystia ischyei ti alla pistis energoumenē di’ agapēs
verses.literal: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value . . . What matters is faith expressing itself through love

verses.original: Ἐτρέχετε καλῶς τίς ἐνέκοψεν ὑμᾶς μὴ πείθεσθαι τῇ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Etrechete kalōs tis enekopsen hymas mē peithesthai tē alētheia
verses.literal: You were running so well Who has obstructed you vvv from obeying the truth

verses.original: ἡ πεισμονὴ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: hē peismonē ouk ek tou kalountos hymas
verses.literal: [Such] persuasion [does] not [come] from the [One] who calls you

verses.original: μικρὰ ζύμη ζυμοῖ τὸ ὅλον φύραμα
verses.transliteration: mikra zymē zymoi to holon phyrama
verses.literal: A little leaven works through the whole batch [of dough]

verses.original: ἐγὼ πέποιθα ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι εἰς ὑμᾶς φρονήσετε οὐδὲν ἄλλο δὲ ὁ ταράσσων ὑμᾶς βαστάσει τὸ κρίμα ὅστις ἐὰν ᾖ
verses.transliteration: egō pepoitha en Kyriō hoti eis hymas phronēsete ouden allo de ho tarassōn hymas bastasei to krima hostis ean ē
verses.literal: I am confident in [the] Lord that - you will take no other view . . . . . . - The [one who is] troubling you will bear the judgment whoever . . . he may be

verses.original: δέ ἀδελφοί εἰ Ἐγὼ ἔτι κηρύσσω περιτομὴν τί ἔτι διώκομαι ἄρα τὸ σκάνδαλον τοῦ σταυροῦ κατήργηται
verses.transliteration: de adelphoi ei Egō eti kēryssō peritomēn ti eti diōkomai ara to skandalon tou staurou katērgētai
verses.literal: Now brothers if I {am} still preaching circumcision why vvv am I still being persecuted In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished

verses.original: οἱ ἀναστατοῦντες ὑμᾶς Ὄφελον καὶ ἀποκόψονται
verses.transliteration: hoi anastatountes hymas Ophelon kai apokopsontai
verses.literal: As for those who are agitating you I wish vvv they would proceed to emasculate themselves

verses.original: γὰρ Ὑμεῖς ἀδελφοί ἐκλήθητε ἐπ’ ἐλευθερίᾳ μόνον μὴ τὴν ἐλευθερίαν εἰς ἀφορμὴν τῇ σαρκί ἀλλὰ δουλεύετε ἀλλήλοις διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης
verses.transliteration: gar Hymeis adelphoi eklēthēte ep’ eleutheria monon mē tēn eleutherian eis aphormēn tē sarki alla douleuete allēlois dia tēs agapēs
verses.literal: For you brothers were called to freedom but [do] not [use] [your] freedom as an opportunity for the flesh Rather serve one another in - love

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ πᾶς νόμος πεπλήρωται ἐν ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ λόγῳ Ἀγαπήσεις σου τὸν πλησίον ὡς σεαυτόν
verses.transliteration: gar ho pas nomos peplērōtai en en tō heni logō Agapēseis sou ton plēsion hōs seauton
verses.literal: - The entire law is fulfilled in . . . - a single decree Love your - neighbor as yourself

verses.original: δὲ εἰ δάκνετε καὶ κατεσθίετε ἀλλήλους βλέπετε μὴ ἀναλωθῆτε ὑπ’ ἀλλήλων
verses.transliteration: de ei daknete kai katesthiete allēlous blepete mē analōthēte hyp’ allēlōn
verses.literal: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another watch out [or] you will be consumed by one another

verses.original: δέ Λέγω περιπατεῖτε Πνεύματι καὶ οὐ μὴ τελέσητε ἐπιθυμίαν σαρκὸς
verses.transliteration: de Legō peripateite Pneumati kai ou mē telesēte epithymian sarkos
verses.literal: So I say walk by [the] Spirit and vvv vvv you will not gratify [the] desires [of the] flesh

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ σὰρξ ἐπιθυμεῖ κατὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος δὲ τὸ Πνεῦμα κατὰ τῆς σαρκός γὰρ ταῦτα ἀντίκειται ἀλλήλοις ἵνα μὴ ποιῆτε ταῦτα ἃ ἐὰν θέλητε
verses.transliteration: gar hē sarx epithymei kata tou Pneumatos de to Pneuma kata tēs sarkos gar tauta antikeitai allēlois hina mē poiēte tauta ha ean thelēte
verses.literal: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh - [They] are opposed to each other so that vvv you do not do what . . . vvv you want

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἄγεσθε Πνεύματι ἐστὲ οὐκ ὑπὸ νόμον
verses.transliteration: de ei agesthe Pneumati este ouk hypo nomon
verses.literal: But if you are led by [the] Spirit you are not under [the] law

verses.original: δέ τὰ ἔργα τῆς σαρκός ἐστιν Φανερὰ ἅτινά ἐστιν πορνεία ἀκαθαρσία ἀσέλγεια
verses.transliteration: de ta erga tēs sarkos estin Phanera hatina estin porneia akatharsia aselgeia
verses.literal: - The acts of the flesh are obvious - - sexual immorality impurity [and] debauchery

verses.original: εἰδωλολατρία φαρμακεία ἔχθραι ἔρις ζῆλος θυμοί ἐριθεῖαι διχοστασίαι αἱρέσεις
verses.transliteration: eidōlolatria pharmakeia echthrai eris zēlos thymoi eritheiai dichostasiai haireseis
verses.literal: idolatry [and] sorcery hatred discord jealousy [and] rage rivalries divisions factions

verses.original: φθόνοι μέθαι κῶμοι καὶ τὰ ὅμοια τούτοις ἃ προλέγω ὑμῖν καθὼς προεῖπον ὅτι οἱ πράσσοντες τὰ τοιαῦτα οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν βασιλείαν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: phthonoi methai kōmoi kai ta homoia toutois ha prolegō hymin kathōs proeipon hoti hoi prassontes ta toiauta ou klēronomēsousin basileian Theou
verses.literal: [and] envy drunkenness orgies and the like . . . - I warn you as I did before that those who practice such things vvv will not inherit [the] kingdom of God

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ καρπὸς τοῦ Πνεύματός ἐστιν ἀγάπη χαρά εἰρήνη μακροθυμία χρηστότης ἀγαθωσύνη πίστις
verses.transliteration: de Ho karpos tou Pneumatos estin agapē chara eirēnē makrothymia chrēstotēs agathōsynē pistis
verses.literal: But the fruit of the Spirit is love joy peace patience kindness goodness faithfulness

verses.original: πραΰτης ἐγκράτεια κατὰ τοιούτων τῶν ἔστιν οὐκ νόμος
verses.transliteration: prautēs enkrateia kata toioutōn tōn estin ouk nomos
verses.literal: gentleness [and] self-control Against such things there is no law

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐσταύρωσαν τὴν σάρκα σὺν τοῖς παθήμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις
verses.transliteration: de Hoi tou Christou Iēsou estaurōsan tēn sarka syn tois pathēmasin kai tais epithymiais
verses.literal: - Those who [belong to] Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with [its] passions and - desires

verses.original: Εἰ ζῶμεν Πνεύματι καὶ στοιχῶμεν Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: Ei zōmen Pneumati kai stoichōmen Pneumati
verses.literal: Since we live by [the] Spirit vvv let us walk in step with [the] Spirit

verses.original: μὴ γινώμεθα κενόδοξοι προκαλούμενοι ἀλλήλους φθονοῦντες ἀλλήλοις
verses.transliteration: mē ginōmetha kenodoxoi prokaloumenoi allēlous phthonountes allēlois
verses.literal: vvv Let us not become conceited provoking - [and] envying one another
